title: Sorghum bran, white, unenriched, dry, raw

content.title: About
content.content: Sorghum bran is the outer layer of the sorghum grain (Sorghum bicolor) obtained after milling. The white variety is lighter in color and has a milder flavor. The product is dry, raw and not enriched with additional vitamins or minerals. Bran is widely used in food processing and cooking as a source of dietary fiber.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Sorghum is one of the most drought‑tolerant crops, grown in arid regions worldwide.
Bran contains over 70 % dietary fiber, making it an excellent fiber source.
White sorghum bran is often added to breads and baked goods to boost nutritional value.
Unlike wheat bran, sorghum bran is gluten‑free, suitable for gluten‑free diets.
Sorghum bran is also used as a feed additive for livestock.

items.title: Rich in dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber supports healthy digestion, regular bowel movements and promotes satiety.

items.title: Low glycemic index
items.content: Bran raises blood sugar slowly, which is beneficial for people with pre‑diabetes or diabetes.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Phenolic compounds help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Source of minerals
items.content: Provides magnesium, phosphorus, iron and zinc important for metabolism.

items.title: Supports cardiovascular health
items.content: Fiber and phytochemicals can help lower cholesterol levels.

items.title: Digestive discomfort
items.content: Large amounts of bran may cause bloating, gas and abdominal discomfort.

items.title: Sorghum allergy
items.content: Although rare, allergic reactions to sorghum products can occur.

items.title: Medication interactions
items.content: High fiber intake can reduce absorption of certain drugs, such as iron supplements.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Add bran to oatmeal, yogurt, smoothies, baked goods, bread, and energy bars. It can also be used as a thickener in sauces. Soaking the bran in water for 10–15 minutes before use helps reduce bitterness.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store dry bran in an airtight container in a cool, dry, dark place. For longer shelf life keep it in the refrigerator to prevent fat oxidation.
